page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn5-c4g1.xlarge is a GPU-accelerated virtual machine running on the KVM hypervisor. The compute foundation consists of an Intel Xeon E5-2682 v4 processor running at 2.5 GHz on the x86_64 architecture, providing 4 dedicated vCPUs backed by 2 physical cores. The CPU features 40 MB of L3 cache and vector extensions including AVX and FMA, though it does not support AVX-512. System memory is configured at 30 GB, providing 7.5 GB per vCPU. Hardware acceleration is provided by a single NVIDIA Pascal P100 GPU equipped with 16 GB of dedicated VRAM. In addition, the instance includes 472 GB of bundled local SSD storage and a baseline network interface speed of 3 Gbps.

Performance profiles reflect the distinction between the legacy host CPU platform and the discrete accelerator. In synthetic CPU assessments, the Xeon E5-2682 v4 posts lower-tier scores in PassMark and stress-ng tests, alongside moderate memory bandwidth numbers. However, the NVIDIA P100 accelerator delivers strong parallel performance in deep learning benchmarks. It achieves 9,863.53 tokens per second on prompt processing for 135M parameter models and 316.25 tokens per second on 7B parameter models, with text generation throughput reaching 42.76 tokens per second on 7B models.

The primary architectural tradeoff lies in pairing an older CPU generation with dedicated GPU hardware. For CPU-bound compilation, high-throughput static web serving, or memory-intensive database operations, the instance exhibits hardware bottlenecks. However, for organizations requiring cost-effective GPU resources without the overhead of current-generation accelerator architectures, the bundled 472 GB SSD provides local scratch capacity for dataset staging. The configuration fits deep learning model inference, parallel scientific computing, and CUDA batch processing tasks.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn5-c4g1.xlarge is a GPU-accelerated instance designed for compute workloads requiring hardware acceleration. Powered by a 2.5 GHz Intel Xeon E5-2682 v4 processor on the x86_64 architecture, it delivers 4 dedicated vCPUs across 2 physical cores and 30 GB of system memory. Compute acceleration is provided by an integrated NVIDIA Pascal P100 GPU with 16 GB of VRAM. The instance also bundles 472 GB of local SSD storage and a 3 Gbps network baseline. While CPU and memory benchmarks show modest throughput on general-purpose workloads, the dedicated P100 GPU achieves strong results in language model inference, delivering 316.25 tokens per second on prompt processing for 7B models. This instance is suitable for machine learning inference, CUDA batch processing, and scientific simulations.
